test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
"The incorrect spelling is option 4, "**Incipid**". The correct spelling is "**Insipid**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**- The word "appease" means to calm or pacify someone.

- The word "aberrant" means deviating from the norm or usual course.

- The word "arbitrary" means based on random choice or personal whim.

- The word "insipid" means lacking flavor or interest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**- It is important to pay attention to spelling in order to effectively communicate in written language.

- Spelling errors can sometimes change the meaning of a word or make it difficult for others to understand what is being communicated."
